reason: The north-only result reproduces (0.316, p=0.37), but the restriction to one region is unjustified and discards two-thirds of the data. On the full sample with the same controls the coefficient is about 0.69 (SE 0.24, p=0.004), and region interactions are insignificant, so there is no evidence the north differs. 'No effect' is only a non-significant, underpowered subsample result, and the effect is positive in the other regions, so the conclusion is unsupported.
